system.description:
Engineers are learned men. They possess the knowledge of the myriad factors used in designing and constructing complex structures. Usually engineers direct a team of masons, carpenters, blacksmiths and laborers in the construction of a building or bridge.

Obstacles: Determining load on structural wall of simple building, Ob 1. Wall, obelisk or column, Ob 2. Stone arch, Ob 3. Stone bridge, Ob 4. Dome, Ob 5. Fortress gate, Ob 6.

FoRKs: Architect, Mason, Carpenter

Skill Type: Artisan. Tools: Yes.

Root: Perception

Source: Burning Wheel Gold Revised, p. 270
